job_description_analysis.job_summary: The Computer Vision Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and deploying computer vision algorithms and systems to process and analyze visual data. The role requires collaboration with teams, optimizing model performance, and integrating vision solutions into production environments. Candidates must have strong programming skills, experience with deep learning frameworks, and the ability to work with large-scale datasets.

Ability to work with large-scale visual data
